sections.Profile:
The "Orbitor 1" pinball machine, produced by Stern Electronics in February 1982, is known for its unique and innovative design. Created by Art Myers and Dixie Reinhardt with mechanics by Joe Joos Jr., it features an unusual concave playfield and spinning rubber bumpers, which create unpredictable ball movement.
